notes.title: Gameplay Update: Input Expansion & Collision Bug Fixes
notes.content:
✨ New Features
[list]
[*] 🐉 Giant creature scenery – Enhanced visual atmosphere with large-scale decorations.
[*] 🔁 New button combo – Allows players to spend energy strategically.
[*] 🎮 Alternate keys for combos – More flexibility in control schemes.
[/list]

🎨 Improvements
[list]
[*] 🖼️ Updated main menu – Redesigned for improved clarity or immersion.
[*] 💬 Message box redesign – Improved readability and cleaner layout.
[/list]

🐛 Bug Fixes
[list]
[*] 🧱 Character stuck on frontal hit – Fixed issue where the character would freeze after frontal collision with an enemy or projectile.
[*] 📊 Stats and win energy fix – Resolved bugs affecting stats display and energy gain mechanics.
[/list]

notes.title: New Sounds, Bug Fixes and Steamworks update
notes.content:
🎮 General Improvements
[list]
[*] The version number is now displayed on the home screen.
[*] Menu titles have a new outlined style for a cleaner look.
[/list]
🧩 Fixes & Bug Corrections
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug with stats and energy gains (winenergy).
[*] Resolved a front-end collision issue.
[*] Fix a few display or loading issues.
[/list]
🔊 Sound Effects
[list]
[*] Added sound effects when gaining energy to enhance feedback and immersion.
[/list]
🧱 Backend & Integration
[list]
[*] Updated Steamworks systems.
[/list]

notes.title: Fixes for 2024-02-08
notes.content:
Bug fixes
- High-speed falls could reach the game's limits
- Lightning speed could remain activated indefinitely
- Several collision issues with scenery
- Sylvio's glitch when facing certain scenery

notes.title: Bug fixes 02-2024
notes.content:
The following fixes have been applied to this version:
- Improved accuracy of scenery collision detection.
- Access to keyboard settings
- Fixed loading during teleportation, which was causing spawn problems.
- Modification of movable elements that disappeared with telekinesis power.
